findings.title: Relative data-dir yields opaque error
findings.message: The flag help says Application Support, but os.UserConfigDir on macOS returns ~/Library/Application Support only when HOME is set. More importantly, a relative -data-dir passed by the user is rejected by OpenRepository (requires absolute), giving a terse ErrInvalid.
findings.suggestion: Convert the flag value with filepath.Abs before calling OpenRepository.

findings.title: Save-then-close blocked by recovery marker failure
findings.message: After a successful save with intent="close" (settleIntent save), completed sets clear=true and starts recovery, but the intent is retained only until recovered runs. If startRecovery fails, intent is cleared and the window never closes, with no feedback beyond status. Also a successful Open with a stale intent="open" is not handled. The close-after-save flow depends on recovery marker success.
findings.suggestion: Close the window after a successful save even if clearing the recovery marker fails, or surface the error explicitly.

findings.title: Stop waits unbounded on ticker goroutine
findings.message: The goroutine exits only on ctx.Done or specific closed errors. If PostWindow returns a different error such as a full queue, the loop keeps going, which is fine. But Stop waits on f.done, and if the queue-full error blocks inside PostWindow, Stop could hang. More importantly, AttachFiles can fail after commands are registered... no, the goroutine starts last. The real risk is that Stop blocks forever on <-f.done if PostWindow blocks.
findings.suggestion: Confirm PostWindow is non-blocking, or bound the wait on f.done with a timeout in Stop.
